_meta.description: Map data from the four eog.gg map tools for all seven kingdoms (Verdantglade, Cinder Ridge, Aqualis, Loong Haven, Aethyris, Harpadia, Ignis): sector and area names, counts of every point-of-interest type, unlock items needed per kingdom, prayer statue and lucky roulette counts, and one marker record per unlock item, prayer statue, roulette and non-gathering point of interest with its position (percent of the map image from the top-left) and the nearest named area. nearest_area is computed by us from label positions and is approximate. Gathering nodes (ore, food, bellflower) are counted but not listed. kind = kingdom | marker.
